text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ――*Haa*, *haa*.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (This thirst... won't subside...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Even running this much isn't enough.
A heat fiery enough to consume this body, an aching sting――)

Truly the wheel of destiny.
A starving beast guided by Ariadne.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ............And who are you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuku. Do the flames of your id scorch
your flesh as always? Or rather――?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It seems your hunger grows fiercer tonight.
If so, take this hand, wandering great wolf.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Allow the God of Destruction to guide you
to a frenzied banquet to quench your fleeting thirst!
*(GITAR RIIIIFF)*

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ............Where is this?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
As you can see,
a battlefield of souls.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I can see that much. ...Why bring me here?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Did I not say? To offer a solitary wandering wolf
a fleeting moment of solace――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Here, all seek proof of existence and commune together.
Just as we do upon the battlefield.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, savor it first, wandering great wolf.
What they yearn for, what they cry out――

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(...Unrefined sound.
Just rushing ahead with no cohesion. And yet――)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(I know it too.
This craving――this unstoppable impulse.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(An impatience that scorches the flesh.
A longing that only swells the more one struggles.
This is――)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How is it? They have gathered for barely half a year,
yet is it not a performance worthy of fueling a hero's soul?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hence, I intend to bear witness to what follows.
To the grand heroic saga they shall weave!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Not particularly.
At best, it simply isn't offensive to the ears.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Do not feign indifference. You took a liking to it, did you not?
It is written upon your face.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Oi, where are you going?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Going back. I've had enough.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh... What a whimsical one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Blood boiling... is it?
............Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ――*Haaah*!

One day, I spotted Narita Brian walking familiarly
into a live music venue.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Well, once in a while isn't so bad.

One day, I spotted Narita Brian walking familiarly
into a live music venue.

text_block_list.name: Livehouse Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're back again?
――You could watch from closer to the front, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No. ...Here is fine.

Narita Brian gazed steadily at the stage.
In her gaze, I felt an intense passion.
